**Planning App Structure**

I'm now outlining the application's core features. The plan includes a curated database of inspirational quotes in `src/data/quotes.ts`, featuring rich metadata for each quote, including author bios and unique IDs. I've been defining the structure for the quote data. Each entry will feature categories like 'Courage' or 'Mindfulness,' along with the source, such as book or speech. There will also be a reflection prompt to deepen the quote's impact.


**Designing User Interactions**

I'm now focusing on user interactions and how to make the app more engaging. I'm planning a segmented tab selector for filtering quotes by category, like "Courage" and "Mindfulness". I'm also planning several interactive actions: copying quotes, listening to audio, marking favorites, managing saved favorites, and exporting quotes as high-resolution images. Finally, I'll include a reflect and journal feature.


**Refining Interface Elements**

I'm now deep in the design phase, specifically the look and layout. I'm following `frontend_design` guidance, aiming for a clean, 3-zone top bar with the wordmark, category controls, and action buttons, including a favorites counter and theme toggle. I'm prioritizing generous paperspace and editorial typography, especially for the quotes. I'm also ensuring full keyboard accessibility and WCAG AA contrast across all color palettes, with smooth motion animations.

export function generateQuoteCardImage(quote: Quote, theme: ThemeConfig): Promise<string> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    const width = 1200;
    const height = 630;
    canvas.width = width;
    canvas.height = height;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

    if (!ctx) {
      resolve('');
      return;
    }

    // Determine colors based on theme
    const isDark = theme.id !== 'warm-paper' && theme.id !== 'minimal-alabaster';
    const bgColor = isDark 
      ? (theme.id === 'forest-moss' ? '#0D1815' : theme.id === 'terracotta-dusk' ? '#1C1412' : '#0E1015') 
      : (theme.id === 'warm-paper' ? '#F9F7F2' : '#FAFAFA');
    const cardBg = isDark ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04)' : 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02)';
    const textColor = isDark ? '#F5F5F4' : '#1C1917';
    const subtextColor = isDark ? '#A8A29E' : '#78716C';
    const accentColor = isDark 
      ? (theme.id === 'forest-moss' ? '#34D399' : theme.id === 'terracotta-dusk' ? '#FB923C' : '#FBBF24')
      : '#92400E';
    const borderColor = isDark ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)' : 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)';

    // Background Fill
    ctx.fillStyle = bgColor;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

    // Subtle Inner Border Frame
    ctx.strokeStyle = borderColor;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.strokeRect(40, 40, width - 80, height - 80);

    // Inner Card container
    ctx.fillStyle = cardBg;
    ctx.fillRect(60, 60, width - 120, height - 120);

    // Top Category & Brand Header
    ctx.fillStyle = accentColor;
    ctx.font = '600 15px "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText(quote.category.toUpperCase(), 100, 115);

    ctx.fillStyle = subtextColor;
    ctx.font = '400 15px "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillText('LUMINA · DAILY WISDOM', width - 100, 115);

    // Divider line
    ctx.strokeStyle = borderColor;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(100, 135);
    ctx.lineTo(width - 100, 135);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Decorative Quotation Mark
    ctx.fillStyle = isDark ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07)' : 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05)';
    ctx.font = 'italic 160px "Cormorant Garamond", Georgia, serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('“', 90, 240);

    // Quote text rendering with auto word-wrap
    ctx.fillStyle = textColor;
    
    // Choose font size based on length
    let fontSize = 38;
    if (quote.quote.length > 180) fontSize = 28;
    else if (quote.quote.length > 120) fontSize = 32;

    ctx.font = `italic 500 ${fontSize}px "Newsreader", "Cormorant Garamond", Georgia, serif`;
    
    const maxTextWidth = width - 240;
    const words = quote.quote.split(' ');
    const lines: string[] = [];
    let currentLine = '';

    for (const word of words) {
      const testLine = currentLine ? `${currentLine} ${word}` : word;
      const metrics = ctx.measureText(testLine);
      if (metrics.width > maxTextWidth && currentLine) {
        lines.push(currentLine);
        currentLine = word;
      } else {
        currentLine = testLine;
      }
    }
    if (currentLine) {
      lines.push(currentLine);
    }

    const lineHeight = fontSize * 1.45;
    const totalTextHeight = lines.length * lineHeight;
    // Vertically center quote in available area (from y=160 to y=460)
    let startY = 170 + ((300 - totalTextHeight) / 2) + fontSize;
    if (startY < 210) startY = 210;

    for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
      ctx.fillText(lines[i], 120, startY + (i * lineHeight));
    }

    // Author & Source Footer
    const footerY = height - 120;
    
    // Hairline rule above author
    ctx.strokeStyle = borderColor;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(120, footerY - 30);
    ctx.lineTo(width - 120, footerY - 30);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Author Name
    ctx.fillStyle = textColor;
    ctx.font = '600 24px "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText(`— ${quote.author}`, 120, footerY);

    // Bio / Source
    ctx.fillStyle = subtextColor;
    ctx.font = '400 16px "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif';
    const sourceText = quote.source ? `${quote.bio} · ${quote.source}` : quote.bio;
    ctx.fillText(sourceText, 120, footerY + 28);

    resolve(canvas.toDataURL('image/png'));
  });
}
